messages:
jamal: Created candidate build rel/1.2.0-c1 and pushed artifacts. Requesting quick sign-off for a small canary tomorrow 09:00-09:30 UTC. Pinning model to model-search@v2.4. QA + SRE please ack.

deploy-bot: [artifact] tag=rel/1.2.0-c1 image=gcr.io/redwood/serve:1.2.0-c1 sha=sha256:7ab4f...
deploy-bot: pinned_versions={"model":"model-search@v2.4"}

ranjit: I'll run the smoke suite and run the perf baseline during canary. ETA to start tests 08:50 UTC so results by 09:10.

sophia: SRE ack. Can we tighten window to 09:00-09:20? I have a rollback slot at 09:40 if needed. Also confirm autoscale policy unchanged.

jamal: Autoscale unchanged. Tighten window to 09:00-09:20 works. Canary size: 2 pods (10% traffic). Rollback plan below.

jamal: Rollback plan: if error rate > 2% or p95 latency regresses > 30% for 5m -> trigger rollback. Rollback command: ```/deploy rollback rel/1.2.0-c1 prod``` Manual rollback will cause traffic to shift to rel/1.1.9 pinned. Ops will coordinate.

maya: Quick note - release notes include: improved prefix caching, small ranking tweak, critical bugfix for truncated completions. Nothing user-facing beyond higher stability. I'll prep the notes now.

alex: Product ack, ok to proceed with canary. I'll notify CS about the minor change set.

ranjit: Smoke checklist brief: auth flows, top-3 intents, streaming through UI, embedding latencies. I'll paste failures here if anything flaps.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: start=2026-03-21T09:00:00Z duration=20m traffic=10% pods=2. Monitoring alert hooks: #eng-oncall, #eng-sre.

jamal: Good. @ranjit please call out any regression in first 10m. If green, I'll run promote to prod at 09:25.

ranjit: 09:12 UTC - smoke green, no obvious errors, p95 within baseline. :tada:

maya: Notes ready and linked: https://internal.redwood.com/releases/1.2.0-c1 (draft).

sophia: SRE final check done. No infra blockers. :thumbsup:

jamal: Promote in 10. Command I'll use (posting for audit):
```
/deploy promote rel/1.2.0-c1 prod --pin model=model-search@v2.4 --annotate \"canary green 2026-03-21\"
```
deploy-bot: Promotion initiated by jamal at 2026-03-21T09:25:08Z. Rolling update to 4 pods, gradual traffic shift over 5m.

alex: Noted. Informing CS and growth that rollout is starting.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete at 2026-03-21T09:31:22Z. Final state: rel/1.2.0-c1 -> prod, pinned model=model-search@v2.4, incidents=0.

jamal: All good on my side. Closing thread, will follow up with post-release quick metrics in #eng-releases after 1h. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
